questions.question: X people were given a contract for doing a piece of work in 34 days. 3 people did not turn up to work due to sickness, and the rest of the people completed the work in 35 days. What is the value of X?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total people = X

Time = 34 days

People absent = 3

New time = 35 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = Men × Days

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total work = X × 34

⇒ Total work = (X − 3) × 35

⇒ X × 34 = (X − 3) × 35

⇒ 34X = 35X − 105

⇒ 35X − 34X = 105

⇒ X = 105

**∴ The correct answer is 105.**

questions.question: Manoj got a new curtain at 50% discount. If Manoj did not get any discount, Manoj would have to pay ₹251 extra. So how much did Manoj pay for the curtain?657
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 50%

Extra amount without discount = 251

**Formula Used:**

Discount amount = Marked price × discount ÷ 100

Paid amount = Marked price − discount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Discount amount = 251

⇒ Marked price × 50 ÷ 100 = 251

⇒ Marked price = 251 × 100 ÷ 50 = 502

⇒ Paid amount = 502 × 50 ÷ 100 = 251

**∴ The correct answer is 251.**

questions.question: The lengths of the two diagonals of a rhombus are 10 cm and 24 cm. Find the length of its perimeter (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diagonal 1 = 10

Diagonal 2 = 24

**Formula Used:**

Side of rhombus = √[(d1 ÷ 2)² + (d2 ÷ 2)²]

Perimeter = 4 × side

**Calculation:**

⇒ Side = √[(10 ÷ 2)² + (24 ÷ 2)²]

⇒ = √[5² + 12²]

⇒ = √[25 + 144]

⇒ = √169 = 13

⇒ Perimeter = 4 × 13 = 52

**∴ The correct answer is 52.**

questions.question: One pipe can fill a tank in 9 minutes while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 90 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-half of the tank?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Filling pipe time = 9 minutes

Emptying pipe time = 90 minutes

Required work = 1/2 tank

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency = LCM ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 9 and 90 = 90

⇒ Efficiency of filling pipe = 90 ÷ 9 = 10

⇒ Efficiency of emptying pipe = 90 ÷ 90 = 1

⇒ Net efficiency = 10 − 1 = 9

⇒ Total work = 90

⇒ Required work = 90 ÷ 2 = 45

⇒ Time = 45 ÷ 9 = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

questions.question: The amount on a sum of ₹2,600 at 20% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = 2600

Rate = 20%

Time = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = Principal × (1 + Rate ÷ 100)Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount = 2600 × (1 + 20 ÷ 100)²

⇒ = 2600 × (1.2)²

⇒ = 2600 × 1.44

⇒ = 3744

**∴ The correct answer is 3744.**

questions.question: The length, breadth and height of a cuboid are in the ratio 5 : 3 : 2. If the total surface area of the cuboid is 992 m², find its volume.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length : Breadth : Height = 5 : 3 : 2

Total surface area = 992

**Formula Used:**

Total surface area = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Volume = l × b × h

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let l = 5x, b = 3x, h = 2x

⇒ 2[(5x × 3x) + (3x × 2x) + (2x × 5x)] = 992

⇒ 2[(15x²) + (6x²) + (10x²)] = 992

⇒ 2 × 31x² = 992

⇒ 62x² = 992

⇒ x² = 16

⇒ x = 4

⇒ Volume = 5x × 3x × 2x

⇒ = 30x³

⇒ = 30 × 64

⇒ = 1920

**∴ The correct answer is 1920.**

questions.question: A number is split into two parts so that one part exceeds the other by 10. If the ratio of the two parts is 7 : 5, write the equation representing this situation by assuming the smaller part to be x.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio = 7 : 5

Difference = 10

Smaller part = x

**Formula Used:**

Ratio = Larger part ÷ Smaller part

**Calculation:**

⇒ Smaller part = x

⇒ Larger part = x + 10

⇒ (x + 10) ÷ x = 7 ÷ 5

⇒ 5(x + 10) = 7x

**∴ The required equation is 5(x + 10) = 7x.**

questions.question: Eight years ago, A was thrice as old as B. Eight years hence, A will be twice as old as B. Find A's present age.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Difference in ages = 8 years

8 years ago: A = 3 × B

8 years hence: A = 2 × B

**Formula Used:**

If present ages are A and B, then past age = present − time and future age = present + time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let present ages be A and B

⇒ A − 8 = 3 × (B − 8)

⇒ A − 8 = 3B − 24

⇒ A = 3B − 16

⇒ A + 8 = 2 × (B + 8)

⇒ A + 8 = 2B + 16

⇒ A = 2B + 8

⇒ 3B − 16 = 2B + 8

⇒ B = 24

⇒ A = 2 × 24 + 8

⇒ A = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

questions.question: The average age of 36 students of a class is 12 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 13 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Extra total = Increase in average × New total

⇒ Increase in average = 13 − 12 = 1

⇒ Extra total = 1 × 37 = 37

⇒ Teacher's age = 12 + 37 = 49

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 36 students = 12 years

Average age of group including teacher = 13 years

Number of students = 36, Total members = 37

**Formula used:**

Total age = Average × Number

Teacher's age = Total age with teacher − Total age of students

**Calculations:**

Total age of students = 12 × 36 = 432 years

⇒ Total age with teacher = 13 × 37 = 481 years

⇒ Teacher's age = 481 − 432 = 49 years

**∴ The correct answer is 49 years.**

questions.question: The product of two numbers is 63 and their difference is 7. The sum of squares of the two numbers is
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the two numbers be x and y.

Given: Product = x × y = 63 and Difference = x − y = 7.

Shortcut: Sum of squares formula = (x − y)² + 2(x × y).

Substitute: (7)² + 2(63) = 49 + 126 = 175.

**∴ Answer = 175**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Product of two numbers = 63, Difference = 7.

**Formula used:**

Sum of squares = (x − y)² + 2(x × y).

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of squares = (7)² + 2(63).

⇒ = 49 + 126 = 175.

**∴ The correct answer is 175.**

questions.question: Amit sells two articles for ₹360 each. On one, he gains 20%, and on the other, he loses 10%. Find the gain or loss percent in the entire transaction. [Answer correct to two places after decimal.]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of each article = 360

Gain on first article = 20%

Loss on second article = 10%

**Formula Used:**

CP = SP × 100 ÷ (100 + profit%)

CP = SP × 100 ÷ (100 − loss%)

Profit/Loss% = (Net profit or loss ÷ Total CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ CP of first article = 360 × 100 ÷ 120

⇒ CP of first article = 300

⇒ CP of second article = 360 × 100 ÷ 90

⇒ CP of second 
article = 400

⇒ Total CP = 300 + 400 = 700

⇒ Total SP = 360 + 360 = 720

⇒ Profit = 720 − 700 = 20

⇒ Profit% = 20 ÷ 700 × 100

⇒ Profit% = 2.857...

⇒ Profit% = 2.86

**∴ The correct answer is 2.86% gain.**

questions.question: Walking at (3)/(7) of his normal speed, Abhijeet is 24 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When walking at 3/7 of his normal speed, time taken increases by the inverse ratio of speed:

Speed ratio = Normal speed: Reduced speed = 7:3 ⇒ Time ratio = 3:7.

Difference in time = 7 − 3 = 4 parts ⇒ 4 parts = 24 minutes.

Usual time = 3 parts = (24 ÷ 4) × 3 = 18 minutes.

**∴ Answer = 18 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Reduced speed = 3/7 of normal speed.

Additional time taken = 24 minutes.

**Formula used:**

Time ratio = Inverse of speed ratio.

Usual time = (Additional time ÷ Time difference ratio) × Normal time ratio.

 Normal Speed Reduced Speed (3/7 × Normal) 
• Time difference = 24 min 

**Calculations:**

Speed ratio = Normal: Reduced = 7:3 ⇒ Time ratio = 3:7.

⇒ Difference in time = 7 − 3 = 4 parts = 24 minutes.

⇒ Usual time = (24 ÷ 4) × 3 = 18 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 minutes.**

questions.question: If 20% of a number is added to 84, then the result is the same number. 60% of the same number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

20% of a number added to 84 gives the same number

**Formula Used:**

x% = x ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number = N

⇒ 84 + 20% of N = N

⇒ 84 + (20 ÷ 100) × N = N

⇒ 84 + 0.2N = N

⇒ N − 0.2N = 84

⇒ 0.8N = 84

⇒ N = 84 ÷ 0.8

⇒ N = 105

⇒ 60% of N = 60 ÷ 100 × 105

⇒ 60% of N = 63

**∴ The correct answer is 63.**

questions.question: Aman and Yogita together invested ₹52,200 in a business. At the end of the year, out of a total profit of ₹5,800, Aman's share was ₹1,700. What was the investment of Aman?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total investment = 52200

Total profit = 5800

Aman’s profit = 1700

**Formula Used:**

Investment ratio = Profit ratio

**Calculation:**

⇒ Aman : Yogita = 1700 : (5800 − 1700)

⇒ = 1700 : 4100

⇒ = 17 : 41

⇒ Total ratio = 17 + 41 = 58

⇒ Aman’s investment = 52200 × 17 ÷ 58

⇒ = 900 × 17

⇒ = 15300

**∴ The correct answer is 15300.**
